book.name: Mak
book.title: Mak Jisas Krais Manö Aij u Mak kalɨ kƚiñ rɨka

content: Jisas uraka
Juda God nɨp sabe gep ñɨn kale u ap padiö, Maria Magdala u, Maria Jems nɨme u, nɨbi Salomi u, wip he u wel lɨ ñun, a göm, am wel haƚɨŋ aij auep rɨmnap rau dap lɨlö hana.
Ruö Sade ñɨn u, sɨb halö uraköm, wip rɨgöl gɨla u areila.
Adan aŋ au aramöl gɨ hagla, “Kabö kub wip rɨgöl ajöŋ pak pɨƚ gɨla u, an ud kɨƚɨƚɨ gɨ goƚ gau yunab?” ö gɨla.
Anɨg hagöm, amjaköm, nɨŋla, kabö kub wip rɨgöl ajöŋ pak pɨƚ gɨla anɨbu, hadö ƚɨƚɨ gɨ am goƚ au mɨdeia.
Nɨŋöm, mɨgan anɨbu hiɨkɨd amöm nɨŋla, bɨ praj waƚɨj rud mɨlöbö yɨma ap, ñɨmagö yɨjɨg lau adö asɨk mɨdeia. Nɨp nɨŋöm pɨñɨŋ gɨla.

Pɨñɨŋ geila, kalɨp haga, “Pɨñɨŋ gagmim. Yad nɨŋbin, kale Jisas bɨ Nasared nɨbö, mab ba laŋ al pak lɨla u nɨp nɨŋnɨg auabim. Pen nɨŋim! Nɨpe aui mɨdagöp. Nɨpe mɨdö nöp uraköm aröp. Nɨp rɨgöl gɨla ka u nöp mɨdöp aui ap nɨŋim.
Pen yɨŋɨd ammil, bɨ nɨpe gau Pida aip hagmil, ‘Jisas nɨpe nöd amöm Galili mɨdeinab. Nɨpe ke kalöp nöd haga rö, kale am nɨpe nɨŋnabim anɨb gau,’ a gɨmil,” a ga.
Anɨg hagö, nɨbi gau anɨnɨn gö, ñɨn ma gɨl gɨl göm, wip rɨgöl höŋ amöm arö göm, gɨ dö gɨ arla. Pɨñɨŋ gɨla nɨŋöm nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap kalɨp manö anɨbu hag ñagla.
Maria Magdala Jisas nɨp nɨŋa
Jisas umöm, ñɨn wañɨgnɨbö u uraköm, nöd yabɨƚ amöm, Maria Magdala mɨdeia au waiö lö, nɨp nɨŋa. Pen nɨbi anɨbu nɨp nöd kɨjaki aiön pi unbö mudun jɨŋ u abaŋ al mɨdeia nɨŋöm Jisas hag höŋ yua.
Nɨpe Jisas nɨp nɨŋöm, am bɨ nɨpe gau mɨɫöŋ gɨ mɨdeila aŋ au amöm, Jisas kamɨŋ mɨdöp nɨp nɨŋbin, a gö, kale böŋ nöp umöb, a göm, manö nɨp u udagla.
Jisas bɨ nɨpe mɨhau adan aŋ au ammil nɨp nɨŋlö
Hainö pen, Jisas bɨ nɨpe mɨhöp ram mɨnöŋ mɨgan ap gɨ ajailö, Jisas bɨ unbö ke rö löm apöm, adan aŋ au waiö lö, nɨp nɨŋmil,
am bɨ nɨpe rɨmnap kalɨp hag ñɨlö u pen, nɨŋö hagabil, a göm, manö kale udagla.
Manö aij yad u nɨbi bɨ gau kalɨp hag ñɨmim, a ga

Hainö mañ ap me, Jisas bɨ nɨpe unbö agɨp laŋ u nan ñɨŋeila aŋ au waiö löm, kalɨp hag göl gɨ haga, “Yad uraknö, nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap yɨp waiö nɨŋöm, apöm kalöp hag ñɨlö, nɨhön gɨnɨg piral hagpal, urakagöp, a gɨmim, nɨŋbim?” ö ga.
Anɨg hagöm, kalɨp haga, “Kale manö aij yad u dam ram mɨnöŋ gau gau magöŋhalö ammim, nɨbi bɨ gau magöŋhalö hag ñɨmim.
Nɨbi bɨ an an, manö aij yad anɨbu nɨŋ udöm, ñɨg paknaböl gau, kamɨŋ arnaböl. Pen nɨbi bɨ an an nɨŋ udagnaböl gau, God kalɨp manö kub hagö ilön udnaböl.

“Nɨbi bɨ manö yɨp nɨŋöm, ‘Nɨŋö hagöp,’ a göm, nɨŋ udnaböl gau, nan gagep rö gɨnaböl. Kɨjaki aiön pi nan gau nɨbi bɨ kalɨp abaŋ alnab gau, hib yad u hagöm, hag höŋ yunaböl. Manö yabɨƚ kale u arö göm, manö gɨsön nɨbö adö ap ke hagnaböl.
Re gadgoƚ nɨbi bɨ hauöp gau ud nɨŋlö, nan ap gö umagnaböl. Nan naij nɨbi bɨ ñɨŋöm umbal gau rɨmnap ñɨŋlö, nan ap gö umagnaböl. Pen nɨbi bɨ nan gɨnab gau, kalɨp ñɨmagö lɨlö, kamɨŋ lɨnab,” a ga.
God Jisas nɨp udöm ram mɨnöŋ nɨpe kumi kabö adö laŋ au ud ara
Bɨ Kub Jisas manö anɨbu kalɨp hag pɨs gö nɨŋöl gɨ, God nɨp udöm, ram mɨnöŋ nɨpe kumi kabö adö laŋ au ud ara. Ud arö, God ñɨmagö yɨjɨg nɨp lau adö asɨka.
Pen bɨ nɨpe gau amöm, Krais manö aij u ram mɨnöŋ gau gau magöŋhalö hag ñɨlö arö nɨŋöl gɨ, Bɨ Kub, manö aij yad nɨŋö lɨnɨm, a göm, kalɨp aip mɨdöm, kƚö ñö, nan gagep rö gau gɨla.
